items.title: Should investors play AI bottlenecks over social media stocks?
items.summary: Should investors bet more on the AI infrastructure bottlenecks than on other tech trends, such as social media? Today's Market Hang panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi, Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski, Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick, and Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management CEO Ross Gerber.

items.title: Alibaba rolls out what it's touting as China's most powerful AI chip
items.summary: Alibaba's (BABA) stock price is climbing premarket after it rolled out a new AI chip, the Zhenwu V900, pitting it against Nvidia chips as a powerful competitor. The 8:30 hosts, Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley, discuss why it may not be a major threat to Nvidia and why China is focusing more on international markets than on domestic ones.

items.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Targets 22,000 GPUs For New Southeast Asia AI Factory Hubs
items.summary: NVIDIA (NasdaqGS: NVDA) and Aolani agreed to deploy 22,000 GPUs across new AI factory sites in Southeast Asia. The partners plan over 100 megawatts of new AI factory capacity, including major hubs in Malaysia and the Philippines. The build out is intended to position Southeast Asia as a global node for AI compute and data center infrastructure.
